question: Where do the retained 2025 GEM solar PV and onshore/unknown wind phases fall inside or outside the original 0.1-degree LCOE candidate cache?
claim: Candidate-cache membership and observed installation location are different spatial objects; quantify their overlap without treating outside-cache sites as proven unsuitable.

panels.b: Onshore and unknown-type wind: 17,759 source phases

data: GEM February 2026 release; operating with known start year <= 2025. Exclude all offshore wind phases.
membership: Containing WGS84 0.1-degree raster cell ID in the original deduplicated cache/<technology>/child_lin_idx.npy; use LCOE.prepare_baseline.grid_indices.
weighting: One equal-size point per source project phase, plotted at original coordinates. No jitter, aggregation, capacity weighting or subsampling.
capacity_basis: Solar MWp/DC using accepted GEM conversion; wind MW. Capacity does not affect position or point size.

design.points_order: deterministic shuffled order to avoid a category always covering the other

checks: All source points within map extent
Candidate input SHA256 and duplicate-record counts
Inspect full and both independent PNGs
interpretation: Membership in the original child cache alone does not identify why a cell is absent. Land filters, climate validity and grid mapping require separate diagnostics. No additional 1-degree parent capacity threshold is imposed in this map.
